repairs.name: GPT-6.1 Sol · separate small repair
limitations: No road/circuit, ground, boundaries, barriers, scenery, markings, start/finish line, checkpoints or environmental collision response exists in the complete 86-line entry source.
Only one red box vehicle is created; no three-car selection, distinct vehicle geometry/statistics, four NPCs, traffic interaction, overtaking/recovery or independent laps exist.

Keyboard state uses e.code but WASD checks use lowercase w/s/a/d rather than KeyW/KeyS/KeyA/KeyD, so those required controls do not activate. Arrow steering only changes carDirection, which is never applied to the car quaternion used for movement.
Movement/turn values are frame-dependent rather than time-scaled; braking clamps speed at zero. C, P/Escape and R, three usable camera views, pause/resume and restart are absent.
No countdown, ordered checkpoint validation, three-lap race, lap timing, positioning, finish detection, standings, menu/selection/results UI or HUD is implemented.

All four screenshot files are byte-identical and show the same lone red box against blue with no track or UI. The report describes nonexistent modules/features and claims comprehensive gameplay verification and 30-60 FPS without supporting measurements.
Original benchmark scores and completeness are unchanged. This is an assisted partial preview, with original report claims retained and potentially inaccurate.
